name: Enhanced Fireball Rune
description: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 20-foot radius.
disable: DC 32 Thievery check (expert) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 27) to counteract the rune

offensiveAbilities.name: Fireball
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the sensor area

Effect The rune detonates a fireball centered on the triggering creature's square. This is a 6th-rank Fireball spell that deals 12d6 fire damage (DC 29 basic Reflex save).
